title: Na Asghar Hai Na sakina
body:
Haaye asghar
Haaye asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
(Haaye asghar, Haay Haay Sakina) x2
<<MINI>>
(Haay asghar Haay Sakina) x3
Haay Sakina
(Zindaan se riha hokar baanu ab kya jaayegi madina Na asghar hai na sakina) x2
Haay asghar
Haay haay sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
(Bibi ke liye kitna mushkil) x2
Is haal mein hoga jeena
<<MINI>>
Na asghar hai na sakina
Zindaan se riha hokar baanu ab kya jaayegi madina
Na asghar hai na sakina
Haay asghar
Haay haay sakina

Khaali jhula shehzaade ka aur khun mein tar ik baali
Jab dekhegi ghar mein aakar zindaan se aane waali
(Tukre tukre hojaayega) x2
Be khanjar uska seena

Na asghar he na sakina

Na asghar he na sakina

Woh bhi pyaasi dunya se gayi aur margaya woh bhi pyasa
(Kisko baali pehnaae ab) x2 aur kisko jhulaae jhula

Yaad aayenge jab apne bachhe chaljaayega dil par khanjar
(Jab saath nahin dengi saansein) x2
Kaise woh rahegi zinda

Aulaad se ronak hoti hai uthta he jo koi laasha
